<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A top bar in four shapes. Axes: layout (inline: brand left, links, button right; split: the brand in the
  middle with the links on both sides; search: a search field with its shortcut in the middle), over (none,
  media: the bar sits over a picture, transparent), actions mode (none, cta), tone (default, inverse: on a dark
  hero band). Turning solid on scroll is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink, NavBarActions, NavSearch } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type NavBarProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  brandHref?: string;
  links: NavLink[];
  current?: string;
  actions?: NavBarActions;
  search: NavSearch;
  tone?: "default" | "inverse";
  layout?: "inline" | "split" | "search";
  over?: "none" | "media";
  skip?: string;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import NavActions from "../components/nav-actions.vue";
import NavBarMenu from "../components/nav-bar-menu.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import NavLinks from "../components/nav-links.vue";
import OverMedia from "../components/over-media.vue";
import SearchPalette from "../components/search-palette.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  brandHref,
  links,
  current = "",
  actions,
  search,
  tone = "default",
  layout = "inline",
  over = "none",
  skip,
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<NavBarProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ theme: [] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="header"
    :class="cn(
      'relative',
      (
        (tone as string) === 'inverse' ? 'border-b border-transparent bg-foreground text-background [&_a]:text-background [&_button]:text-background'
        : 'border-b border-border bg-background'
      ),
      (((over as string) === 'media') ? 'isolate overflow-hidden border-0 bg-transparent' : '')
    )"
    :data-layout="layout"
    :data-tone="tone"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="nav-bar"
  >
    <OverMedia :on="((over as string) === 'media')" :alt="brand" />
    <LinkPlain v-if="skip"
      href="#main-content"
      :class="'sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-2 focus:top-2 focus:z-50 focus:rounded focus:bg-background ' +
        'focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:inset-ring focus:inset-ring-border'"
      data-slot="skip-link"
    >
      {{ skip }}
    </LinkPlain>
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" data-slot="container">
      <Box :class="cn('flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4', 'py-4')">
        <NavBlock v-if="((layout as string) === 'split')"
          :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', label, landmarkLabel)) : label)"
          class="w-full"
          testid="site-nav"
        >
          <Grid cols="1-3" class="w-full items-center gap-4">
            <Box class="md:justify-self-start">
              <NavLinks :links="links" :current="current" side="left" />
            </Box>
            <Box class="text-center">
              <MenuEntry :href="brandHref" class="text-lg font-medium" testid="brand">
                {{ brand }}
              </MenuEntry>
            </Box>
            <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="end" class="flex-wrap md:justify-self-end">
              <Box>
                <NavLinks :links="links" :current="current" side="right" />
              </Box>
              <NavActions
                :login="actions?.login"
                :loginHref="actions?.loginHref"
                :cta="actions?.cta"
                :ctaHref="actions?.href"
                :actions="actions?.mode"
                :tone="tone"
                :themeLabel="actions?.themeLabel"
                @theme="() => emit('theme')"
              />
            </Group>
          </Grid>
        </NavBlock>
        <template v-else>
          <MenuEntry :href="brandHref" class="text-lg font-medium" testid="brand">
            {{ brand }}
          </MenuEntry>
          <SearchPalette v-if="((layout as string) === 'search')" :label="search.label" :shortcut="search.shortcut" />
          <NavBarMenu :label="label" :links="links" :current="current" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
          <NavActions
            :login="actions?.login"
            :loginHref="actions?.loginHref"
            :cta="actions?.cta"
            :ctaHref="actions?.href"
            :actions="actions?.mode"
            :tone="tone"
            :themeLabel="actions?.themeLabel"
            @theme="() => emit('theme')"
          />
        </template>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
